summary: OSpec 1.9.0 gives every Goal one fast quality workflow: deterministic planning preflights, one independent combined planning review, bounded repair, conflict-safe implementation, independent task review, integration review, and fresh verification.
new: Added deterministic inline preflights for design and implementation-plan readiness before task graph derivation.
Added one independent combined planning review across requirements, architecture, task boundaries, dependencies, and verification coverage.
Added compact Loop JSON output that keeps executable action data while omitting repeated adapter diagnostics.
improved: Goals now use one quality path without workflow levels or repeated per-document reviewer rounds.
Planning preflights reserve no model tokens and reuse current evidence until authoritative inputs change.
A planning failure receives at most one grouped repair and one fresh combined re-review before stopping stably.
Final review focuses on integration and unresolved deltas instead of replaying every accepted task review.
Red tests, production implementation, and green/refactor evidence remain in one atomic task unless the test harness is independently reusable.
fixed: Task graph derivation is now explicitly sequenced after design and plan preflights.
Incomplete planning documents, required decisions, and unfinished checklists fail before worker dispatch.
Identical planning snapshots no longer create duplicate review dispatches.
Planning repair state is transactionally bound to one Loop action and cannot be redispatched after failure or completion.
Empty pending actions settle without entering an observation loop, and old Goal controller contracts stop with a stable migration error.
docs: Updated Goal workflow, controller, and multilingual usage guidance for the fast planning path.
